Makeup.Configured Block Size: The Block Size the FS was Formatted in
Makeup.Configured Cluster Map Size: The Cluster Map the FS was Formatted in
Version Code: The Version Data for the FileSystem.

Log Block[1 full sector].Source: 8-bit Log Alias, If multiple Items have the same Log Alias, they are considered part of the Operation
Log Block[1 full sector].Destination: 8-bit Log Alias, Multiple Items cannot have the same Log Alias, they should be considered corrupted

File Code: The Associative File Code for a Sector/Block. A value of 0 means the Sector/Block is Unused, whilst a Value of 1 means the Sector/Block is Reserved, Any other value associates with another File
Made up of a Hash of it's Full Path
